tasks.label: Build NSIS installer (skip native rebuild)
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:SKIP_NATIVE_REBUILD='1'; & { Set-Location 'F:\download app hr'; .\scripts\build.ps1 all }"

tasks.label: Build NSIS installer for v1.7.7
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:SKIP_NATIVE_REBUILD='1'; Set-Location 'F:\download app hr'; .\scripts\build.ps1 all"

tasks.label: Build NSIS installer via cmd
tasks.command: cd /d F:\download app hr && set SKIP_NATIVE_REBUILD=1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build.ps1 all

tasks.label: Build installer with PowerShell script
tasks.command: set SKIP_NATIVE_REBUILD=1 && set CI=true && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "scripts/build.ps1" all

tasks.label: Publish GitHub release from existing build output
Run installer build through cmd
tasks.command: cmd /d /c "cd /d F:\download app hr && set SKIP_NATIVE_REBUILD=1 && set CI=true && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build.ps1 all"

tasks.label: Verify GitHub release upload
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location 'F:\download app hr'; gh release view v1.7.7 --repo raymondwalkerhs-spec/hangup-hr --json tagName,name,assets"
